ambiguities.explanation: The adverb 'redundantly' is polysemous, having multiple meanings in the context of communication protocols. It can imply either that there are two or more connections for fault tolerance (to ensure continued operation even if one connection fails) or that the same information is transmitted over both CAN and LIN to increase reliability.
possible_interpretations: The TCU has two separate, independent connections to the ORC via CAN and LIN, ensuring continued communication in case of a single failure.

The TCU sends duplicate messages over both CAN and LIN, increasing the likelihood that at least one message will be received by the ORC even if there is interference or other issues with either connection.
